svg.desc: A ray · q = 5 · H = 5x − y · z = 1/8 · physical clock t = x The pinned selector tries E1 and then E2, using the first integer at or above each lower endpoint and retaining equality. This figure reproduces q=5. The source gives the separate all-q argument; the picture does not prove it. The requested output is one 1/8 witness, not the optimum, all safe times, or a transfer guarantee. Restore the richer cells when the question changes.
